\[ P(X = k) = \binom{n}{k} p^k (1-p)^{n-k} \]
where \( n \) is the number of trials, \( k \) is the number of successful trials, \( p \) is the probability of success on a single trial, and \( \binom{n}{k} \) is the binomial coefficient.
